listening.title: Chốt hợp đồng với khách hàng

lines.speaker: Tuan (sales rep)
lines.text: Thanks for meeting again, Mai. Are we ready to wrap up the negotiation today?

lines.speaker: Mai (client)
lines.text: Yes, our legal review is complete. The contract terms look fine to us.

lines.speaker: Tuan (sales rep)
lines.text: Great news. I'll send the final version with an e-signature link.

lines.speaker: Mai (client)
lines.text: Perfect. Once I sign on the dotted line, when do we start onboarding?

lines.speaker: Tuan (sales rep)
lines.text: We can start within a week after it becomes a binding agreement.

lines.speaker: Mai (client)
lines.text: Sounds good. My team is excited to finally ink the deal.

lines.speaker: Tuan (sales rep)
lines.text: We appreciate your trust. This partnership means a lot to us.

lines.speaker: Mai (client)
lines.text: Just to confirm, the pricing matches what we discussed last week?

lines.speaker: Tuan (sales rep)
lines.text: Yes, nothing has changed in the contract terms since then.

lines.speaker: Mai (client)
lines.text: Great, I'm signing now through the e-signature link.

lines.speaker: Tuan (sales rep)
lines.text: Wonderful! This will really help our close ratio this quarter.

lines.speaker: Mai (client)
lines.text: Congratulations, and thank you for being so patient with us.
